additional_species_in_order.name: Loxodonta_africana
additional_species_in_order.assembly: HAL asset; do not infer assembly from taxon-proxy accession

selection_rule: Choose the best absolute conserved-base fraction on chr1 at 5%, ties: lower nominal seeds per bin (prespecified memory proxy), fewer species, score lexical order. Also freeze best score for every panel/sampling cell (3 fixed rates plus bottom16/bottom32); evaluate all frozen cells once on chr3 and report entire matrix.
primary_comparison: Selected extension setting versus three-species k25 any_copy4 at 1/4 sampling on the same fresh chromosome. Paired 1 MiB block bootstrap, 200 resamples.
memory_comparison: Byte-identical compact vs baseline scores on the original query chromosomes; global synthetic exact partitioning benchmark if compact table alone is insufficient. Record preparation, construction, score, selection, disk bytes, RSS separately.
biological_strata: Exploratory annotated CDS, exon, UTR, promoter, cCRE, repeat class and family composition on the preserved chr2 pilot and fresh chr3 result. No annotation-based parameter tuning.
spatial_robustness: Synthetic 50/100/150/300bp planted tracts with 0/5/10/20% substitution, 0/1% indels and randomized bin offsets; report localization and neutral false selection.
labels: Reuse pilot bigWig and definition; do not inspect chr3 conservation labels until selection is published.
resource_limit: Same single c7i.4xlarge until 2026-09-16T23:20Z; cumulative authorized EC2 costs <=$30; no production run or training.
bottom_hash_definition: For each complete 100bp query bin, hash all valid canonical k25 words assigned by end position, deduplicate, and keep the smallest N. Count exact occurrence and species prevalence of retained query words against all words of every complete support genome, not only support sketches.
